title: Evidence-Guided Recovery for AI Agents with Ambiguous Tool Outcomes and Partial Execution
title_zh: 面向工具结果模糊与部分执行场景的AI智能体证据引导恢复

paragraphs.en: 提出面向工具结果模糊与部分执行场景的证据引导恢复框架，显著提升AI智能体任务完成率。 Tool timeouts can leave AI agents facing ambiguous tool outcomes and partial execution: an action may have failed, committed or remained in flight while other workflow steps have already completed. We formulate evidence-guided task recovery over approved obligations, provider capabilities and states compatible with public evidence. A shared admissibility check handles key expiry, authorization timing, dependencies and residual effects; a terminal certificate separates actual goal satisfaction from publicly supported safe completion. The known-model implementation combines standard observation-contingent planning with a separately implemented effect-history adjudicator. In a finite study of 37 assignments, planning and three active controls each certify 28 completions; four saved synthetic fee units incur additional computation. A preregistered assignment-held-out comparison then evaluates planning advice against evidence prompting with two local model bundles. Across 58 paired units in 19 previously developed task families, advice certifies 30 completions versus 9, a 36.2-percentage-point difference (exact family sign-flip p=0.0078), using 272 proposals versus 399. All 116 trajectories pass independent replay. Both models exhibit a positive completion difference. The comparison measures the evaluated advice interface under a common shield; search-versus-rule advice requires a separate matched comparison. Unknown and handoff outcomes remain explicit, with guarantees tied to the declared provider capabilities rather than arbitrary third-party exactly-once execution.
paragraphs.zh: 提出面向工具结果模糊与部分执行场景的证据引导恢复框架，显著提升AI智能体任务完成率。工具超时可能使AI智能体面临模糊的工具结果和部分执行：某个动作可能已失败、已提交或仍在进行中，而工作流的其他步骤已经完成。 我们在已批准的义务、提供方能力以及与公开证据兼容的状态之上，形式化定义了证据引导的任务恢复。 一个共享的可采性检查处理密钥过期、授权时机、依赖关系和残余影响；一个终态证书将实际目标达成与公开支持的安全完成区分开来。 已知模型的实现将标准的基于观测的规划与单独实现的效应历史裁决器相结合。 在一项包含37个任务的有限研究中，规划与三个主动对照各自认证了28个完成；节省的四个合成费用单元带来了额外的计算开销。 随后，一项预注册的任务留出对比评估在两个本地模型包下将规划建议与证据提示进行了比较。 在19个先前开发的任务族共58个配对单元中，建议认证了30个完成，而证据提示认证了9个，相差36.2个百分点（精确的任务族符号翻转 p=0.0078），使用的提案数量为272对399。 全部116条轨迹均通过独立重放验证。 两个模型均表现出正的完成差异。 该对比在共同防护下度量所评估的建议接口；搜索型建议与规则型建议需要单独的匹配对比。 未知结果与移交结果保持显式，其保证与声明的提供方能力绑定，而非依赖任意的第三方恰好一次执行。
